queries_run: McKesson market share Cencora Cardinal Health pharmaceutical distribution 2026
McKesson new entrant threat oncology specialty distribution competitor 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 指出主要對手為 Cencora 與 Cardinal Health；Oncology & Multispecialty 另與專科經銷商、GPO、專科藥局、腫瘤網絡競爭，Cencora、Cardinal 亦提供經銷＋GPO＋提供者服務組合。
findings.excerpt: Our primary competitors in distribution, wholesaling, and logistics are Cencora, Inc. and Cardinal Health, Inc.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：越來越多新競爭進入者在資料分析、機器學習、AI 等技術上比公司更有經驗。
findings.excerpt: Additionally, some of our historical competitors and a growing number of new competitive entrants have more experience than we do in enabling technologies such as data analytics, machine learning, or AI.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 搜尋未找到具名新進入者或明確份額消長方向的可靠來源；聚合站份額數字（41/35/22）未證實，未採用。
